entities.name: ESM message container
entities.description: An information element that enables piggybacked transfer of a single ESM message within an EMM message. It is a type 6 information element and contains an ESM message coded without NAS security header.

entities.name: ESM message container IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for the ESM message container, located in octet 1.

entities.name: Length of ESM message container contents
entities.description: Length field spanning octets 2-4, indicating the size of the ESM message container contents.

entities.name: ESM message container contents
entities.description: Contains the actual ESM message container contents, which can be any ESM PDU as defined in clause 8.3, with a maximum size of 65535 octets.

entities.name: ESM message
entities.description: A single ESM message that is piggybacked within an EMM message via the ESM message container. It is coded without NAS security header as specified in clause 8.3.

entities.name: EMM message
entities.description: An EMM message that can carry the ESM message container information element to enable piggybacked transfer of an ESM message.

entities.name: Coding without NAS security header
entities.description: Specifies that the ESM message included in the ESM message container must be coded as per clause 8.3, without a NAS security header.

relations.description: The ESM message container information element includes the IEI identifier in octet 1.
The ESM message container information element includes a length field spanning octets 2-4.
The ESM message container information element includes the contents field which holds the ESM message.
The ESM message container contents field contains a single ESM message.
An EMM message can contain the ESM message container information element for piggybacked transfer.
The condition that the ESM message must be coded without NAS security header applies to the ESM message contained in the ESM message container.
